claimBoundary.provesIfPasses: Benchmark-scoped evidence that the real llama-swiglu pipeline can discover selected attention heads and MLP units for factual prompts, then validate an ordered attention->residual->MLP->target path by showing selected attention interventions change selected MLP activations above full-control path interventions while the combined circuit remains causally effective on the target logit.
claimBoundary.doesNotProve: This is not full-model circuit recovery, not exhaustive residual-stream patching for every edge, not full FFN extraction, not arbitrary LLM understanding, not output-only original-neuron identity, and not a broad SOTA claim.
